# Four Servants, part of Telemachus Leading Theoclymenus to Penelope from The Story of Odysseus

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Four Servants, part of Telemachus Leading Theoclymenus to Penelope from The Story of Odysseus
- **Artist / Maker:** After a design by Jacob Jordaens (1593–1678) Woven at the workshop of Jan van Leefdael (1603–1668) Brussels
- **Date:** c. 1650
- **Style / Period:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** weaving - tapestry
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 462
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/462
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/177454db-4504-cf82-0683-70990be7bf9c/full/400,/0/default.jpg
